# FysikLab v1 pipeline fixture — not installed

`fysiklab-default.json` is a ready-to-paste **`pipeline` property**, not a replacement for the repository's current lanes/settings. It is also copied to the requested handoff at `~/.review-inbox/handoffs/agent-office/pipelines/fysiklab-default.json`. No FysikLab checkout was changed.

The 92-node DAG flattens the design's grouped skill outputs into explicit checks, captures and scoped reports. Five work kinds, authoring target/format/spec, founder-named critic subsets, independent risk flags, dispatch/full/doc tiers, final visual evidence, presentation and explicit acceptance converge on **dev**, not release. Framework architecture and new-chapter physics/frame/non-core Danish cannot be disabled through generic risk flags. Dispatched new content retains both full authoring checks and `check:changed`.

Every activated step is required. Optionality is a false guarded branch, never a `required: false` node. All 23 fields are explicitly selected; inactive-context fields may use ordinary harmless values (critic subsets `none`, booleans false). The first mate records semantic scope and why those choices apply. Path rules reject executable changes on docs-only and require architecture/visible flags on concrete workflow/dependency/route/asset/locale surfaces. These are conservative path guards, not semantic inference.

- Generic architecture/scientific flags mean **additional scope not already covered** by framework/authoring reports; reuse an adequately scoped report rather than launching a second advisory round.
- Ordinary dispatched fix slices activate architecture/physics only when relevant, plus worker offline regressions. They bypass the Danish/legal/SEO/taste/final-audit roster. A requested whole-chapter audit is a separate, explicitly scoped procedure.
- `/blender` remains a separate asset-repository workflow; `/drift-sweep` remains read-only adoption investigation; `retro-keeper` via `/improvement-review` remains an opt-in read-only evidence audit. They are catalogue resources, **not** a dev delivery tax. All other discovered agents/skills are backed by explicit nodes.
- Evidence is scoped and attributed, then endorsed by the lead. v1 conservatively invalidates completions on changed intended bytes; the lead can reattach/re-endorse a still-applicable planning/design artifact with its scope explanation, without fabricating or re-running a reviewer. A pure commit/staging transition with the same intended tree preserves receipts after an explicit candidate refresh.
- `gate` is preflight only. The terminal instructs the **first mate** to use the canonical landing tool and confirm normal `origin/dev` publication. `publication-pending` is unfinished; retry `publish`, never re-land. Only after publication may linked fixed markers and the actual landed/published receipt be reported. v1's office ledger does not claim it executed or observed a Git publication.

Before adoption, FysikLab's owners must reconcile its canonical charter/skill call sites with lead-owned scheduling/evidence and lead-only delivery, install/trust repo-local guards on each delivery machine, and test scope/branch/outage cases. This fixture does not grant live voice/model calls, main pushes or PR merges.
